Use case: stylized-concept. NEW KFB cartoon CLAYMATION ink monster RPG TIER TRIPLET SHEET. Actual input image1 ORIGINAL freche-family is BODY/MATERIAL style reference; image2 ORIGINAL RPG sheet is PROP CRAFT reference. These are STYLE references only, NOT edit targets. Invent new cast, don't copy reference faces, don't copy previous pilot warrior/mage. ONE landscape1536x1024 TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG, exactly THREE COLUMNS x TWO ROWS = SIX COMPLETE standalone figures. EACH ROW ONE unique identity repeated at3stages LEFT TRASH, MIDDLE COMMON, RIGHT ELITE. Keep row-specific contour family, teeth, headwear/colour signature across3; change acting and readable gear. Two identities total, six depictions. Female row repeats3times intentionally. Do not print headings or labels.
CRITICAL LAYOUT: SIX equal512x512 CELLS. Each COMPLETE figure including props/droplets must fit in its own cell with32px transparent margin all sides. Similar body height about320px, total height max440px. All sword/hood/staff tips stay well inside own cell. No crossing x512/x1024 or y512, no overlap, no crop. Never grow elite to boss size.
STYLE INVARIANTS: whole FOOTLESS continuous charcoal-black ink splat bodies with subtle violet sheen; thick softly rounded asymmetrical goo lobes, hands continuous goo, exposed body dominant. UPRIGHT facing viewer/front3quarter. Rich modeled plasticine, tactile fingerprints, soft sculpted lids/lips, uneven ivory teeth. Clearly WHITE/ivory eyeballs surrounding separate RED iris and BLACK pupil, even when half-lidded. Never all-red eyes. Cartoon acting at expressive peak, offbeat handmade stop-motion, not Pixar cute baby mascots, not realistic human bodies/dolls. No feet/legs, no full robes/armour replacing goo, no skinny limbs, no hypercomplex gear. Few beautiful fat wooden/cloth/metal/clay prop volumes; simple physical relation and satirical character, no floating punctuation or random anatomy.

TOP ROW: FEMALE-READ HOARDER. FIXED IDENTITY across3: very wide upright rounded trapezoid ink splat with THREE tiny crown nubs and a low plum rolled fringe, lashes, one square lower tooth and short gold upper fang, tiny faded ochre explorer cap with teal stitch, short indigo collar.
LEFT TRASH: Anxious asymmetrical huge eyes, defensive crooked lower lip. Hugs ONE very small battered wooden treasure BOX containing ONE visibly worthless bent spoon.
MIDDLE COMMON: Suspicious narrowed sideways eyes, clenched uneven teeth. SAME box now iron-banded with spoon plus TWO big smooth odd buttons, lid tilts but all contained.
RIGHT ELITE: Blissful possessive squint and stubborn closed-lip smile, body wraps protectively around SAME compact brass-banded box with spoon and THREE chunky trinkets. Same cap/collar, no huge pile/coins scattered.

BOTTOM ROW: male DUNGEON-MASTER. FIXED IDENTITY across3: upright lanky tall hooked ink bean, one long floppy crown lobe, uneven WHITE/red/black eyes behind thick round brass spectacles, big solitary LOWER tooth, little moss-green cap and plum collar.
LEFT TRASH: Overwhelmed wide gaze, worried stretched lower lip. Holds ONE folded blank cardboard GM SCREEN with TWO short panels low at own belly, no desk.
MIDDLE COMMON: Delighted conspiratorial raised brow, crooked underbite. Same two-panel screen now worn leather with ONE plain abstract embossed spiral, other hand holds ONE large blank faceted clay DIE.
RIGHT ELITE: Dry authoritarian half-lids and pursed crooked lip. Same little screen with modest copper corners, same faceted die now polished bone/brass dots only. Screen stays LOW so ink face/body remain dominant, no table or extra players.
EMPTY SPACE AND HOLES HAVE ACTUAL ALPHA ZERO, no coloured backdrop/gradient/scenery/floor/cast shadow/shadow disc/checkerboard/text/logos/borders. Opaque figures with soft edge antialias only. Materials/lighting cohesive, each ROW different face choreography, no universal angry V-brow grin. Gear escalation stays plausible and simple; absurdity comes from behaviour and objects, not clutter.
LAYOUT OVERRIDE: make ALL figures SMALLER with at least64px clear margin per512px cell, total figure bounding box MAX384x384 pixels. Centres at(256,256),(768,256),(1280,256),(256,768),(768,768),(1280,768). Preserve complete big thick blob design but leave generous invisible gutters, don't fill the canvas. Uniform equal boxes, no protrusions crossing cell boundaries.
